cityCount.description: The number of citys to create.

initialInfectionProbability.label: Initial Infection Probability
initialInfectionProbability.description: The probability that any given individual will be infected at the beginning of the model run. For example, if this value is .15, and their are 100 individuals in the model, roughly 15 of those individuals will be infected at time 0.

minContactTransmissionProbability.label: Min Contact Transmission Probability
minContactTransmissionProbability.description: The probability that proximity to a single neighbor for a single period will result in transmission of infection.

maxContactTransmissionProbability.label: Max Contact Transmission Probability
maxContactTransmissionProbability.description: The probability that proximity to a single neighbor for a single period will result in transmission of infection.

caseMortalityRate.label: Case Mortality Rate
caseMortalityRate.description: The probability that death will occur for a given individual as a result of infection.

minPeriodExposure.label: Min Period Exposure
minPeriodExposure.description: Minimum time from initial exposure to infectious asymptomatic or symptomatic state. 0 or greater.

maxPeriodExposure.label: Max Period Exposure
maxPeriodExposure.description: Maximum time from initial exposure to infectious asymptomatic or symptomatic state. 0 or greater.

minPeriodAsymptomInfection.label: Min Period Asymptom Infection
minPeriodAsymptomInfection.description: Maximum time spent infected without showing symptoms. 0 or greater.

maxPeriodAsymptomInfection.label: Max Period Asymptom Infection
maxPeriodAsymptomInfection.description: Maximum time spent infected without showing symptoms. May be zero!

minPeriodSymptomInfection.label: Min Period Symptom Infection
minPeriodSymptomInfection.description: Minimum time spent infected with obvious symptoms. 0 or greater.

maxPeriodSymptomInfection.label: Max Period Symptom Infection
maxPeriodSymptomInfection.description: Maximum time spent infected with obvious symptoms. 1 or greater.

movementProbability.label: Movement Probability
movementProbability.description: The liklihood that an agent will move within a given period.

regionalLocationCount.label: Regional Location Count
regionalLocationCount.description: The number of regional locations to create.

city.label: City
city.description:
A simple model of epidemic dynamics. We define individual agents with different disease states. The progression of disease moves from succeptible to exposed to infectious (either symptomatic or asymptomatic) to some outcome state. Agents can transmit infection to their immediate neighbors.

For some background on the general approach, see Joshua M. Epstein. "Generative Social Science". 2006. Princeton.
